items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: We had another guy on baritone... There was Hilton Jefferson, Walter Thomas, Andrew Brown...

ctx.x: Why don't we just get back to the bands...

Now, here's another thing I did, that happened. After I studied, Andrew Brown, he studied. And then when Jefferson come in the band, Jefferson studied. And I'll tell you just one thing about Hilton Jefferson. He got that system faster than anybody I've ever seen. Because Jefferson was a good... He was a good saxophone player, but he had a small tone; he didn't have no big tone. But see, Merle, the way Merle taught you to play, you had a big sound. And I'll tell anybody this. Nobody had a saxophone section like we…
[INAUDIBLE NAME] talks about studying with Merle Johnson.
